spikes.blood.e.0.qualification: Original source composes cropped generated 9x34px spike and9x5px socket raster components at authored 2:1 screen grid positions; known centres/heights do not define spike faces or normals. Later per-view extruded destruction scenes are explicit reconstructions, not original mesh evidence; no later endpoint proxy or newly invented thickness is promoted.

spikes.blood.e.1.qualification: Registered inferred per-spike visible cone faces and floor sockets, anchored to the original nine authored component centres and reveal crops. No exact hidden cross-section, rigid vendor mesh or gameplay collider is claimed. Original colour/alpha, resources, registration and phase identity are unchanged.
